startingEnvelope.applicationAuthentication: Production OIDC with application-owned binding and authority; current access switch disabled

RC3-AUTH-001.finding: Production OIDC is runtime-proven against Google Identity Services using the RS256/JWKS signature-first verifier. A verified bound Google subject resolved through the application binding store and authenticated the member read path. Missing bearer traffic failed closed with HTTP 401. Production application access has been returned to disabled after rehearsal.

RC3-BIND-001.finding: Runtime proof confirms a verified Google subject resolves to a durable application participant with ACTIVE membership and governed member scopes; the same member identity was denied operator access with HTTP 403. Durable participant, membership, authority-grant and binding referential integrity is enforced in Production. Runtime falsification of an otherwise-valid unbound subject and a disabled application principal remains outstanding.

RC3-ENV-001.finding: Production OIDC issuer, audience, JWKS and DATABASE_URL configuration are present and were runtime-proven during the bounded identity-enabled rehearsal. Readiness reported oidcConfigured=true, applicationBindingStoreConfigured=true and identityRuntimeReady=true while the bounded access switch was enabled. After rollback, the same readiness endpoint reports productionApplicationAccessEnabled=false and identityRuntimeReady=false as designed.

RC3-LOG-001.finding: Production runtime logs from the identity-enabled rehearsal showed only route/status metadata for the exercised OIDC paths. No bearer token material, Google subject, issuer value or provider secret material was observed.

RC3-PAY-001.finding: Paystack authenticity/replay semantics remain proven in test mode only. Paystack live-mode activation and live funds remain explicitly unauthorized and were not exercised during RC3 identity rehearsal.

RC3-ROLLBACK-001.finding: Rollback is runtime-proven both by the earlier disabled canary rehearsal and by the post-identity-enabled rehearsal rollback. Current Production deployment dpl_4ZsMXXgLjjHHyAJPKwvLQVFZaUjm has production application access disabled; readiness reports identityRuntimeReady=false and /api/member-orders returns HTTP 503 PRODUCTION_APPLICATION_ACCESS_DISABLED.

RC3-REHEARSAL-001.finding: The bounded Production identity-enabled rehearsal passed for the governed member positive path, unauthenticated member/operator denial, member-to-operator denial, log hygiene, and rollback. Runtime adversarial coverage still lacks an otherwise-valid unbound Google subject and a disabled application principal. These cases must pass before the identity rehearsal blocker is closed.
